claim_text: All core operations... run entirely on the user's device
verified_reality: On-device by default; escalates to PCC for context overflows (>4K tokens) or Deep Think modes
verification_notes: Policy evaluation determines route and can escalate to PCC

claim_text: PCC routes to Apple's secure Private Cloud Compute enclaves
verified_reality: PCC remote enclave execution is simulated locally on SystemLanguageModel.default via compatibility wrapper
verification_notes: PCC routes resolve to local compatibility wrappers

claim_text: dense vectors are written into BNNSVectorDatabase
verified_reality: Vectors are memory-mapped using mmap for zero-copy access in BNNSVectorDatabase
verification_notes: Verified explicit use of mmap in database load methods

claim_text: Library databases are separate SQLite files for isolation
verified_reality: All containers share tables inside the local SQLite database using container_id column isolation
verification_notes: Verified tables are shared and column-isolated

claim_text: Syncs workspace libraries across devices via CloudKit
verified_reality: iCloud workspace sync uses iCloud Drive (Ubiquity) via NSFileCoordinator and NSMetadataQuery sweeps, not CloudKit
Chat history is persistent and serialized to JSON files in the background
verification_notes: Verified comment exists but contradicts actual JSON persistence code

claim_text: Standard mode uses 3B Core with 4,096-token context limit
verified_reality: Standard mode executes on SystemLanguageModel.default capped at 4K tokens
verification_notes: Verified token budget matches the default route policy
